notes:
v0.3.4 — Fix Flicker (MPO) + Save Editor temp-folder fix.
• New: 'Fix Flicker' button re-enables Multi-Plane Overlay to clear fullscreen flickering — always safe, and now also applied automatically when you turn Work Mode OFF and when you restore.
• Fixed: Save Editor 'Could not generate' / WinError 3 that happened when the Windows Temp folder was cleared — save templates now survive a Temp wipe and a missing Temp folder is recreated automatically.
